tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Boundary oscillation estimate] 1. ch8:8.27\group ch08-generalized-solutions Under the hypotheses of Theorem 8.22, suppose $\Omega $ has an exterior cone at $x_0\in \partial \Omega $. For $B_0=B_{R_0}(x_0)$ and $0<R\leq R_0$, \begin{equation} \osc _{\Omega \cap B_R(x_0)}u \leq C\left(R^\alpha \left(R_0^{-\alpha }\sup _{\Omega \cap B_0}|u|+k\right) +\sigma (\sqrt{RR_0})\right), \tag {8.72} \end{equation} where $\sigma (r)=\osc _{\partial \Omega \cap B_r(x_0)}u$ and $C,\alpha >0$ depend only on $n,\Lambda /\lambda ,\nu ,q,R_0$, and the cone $V_{x_0}$ as in the baseline statement.
Proof

\sketch Apply Theorem 8.26 to $M_{4R}-u$ and $u-m_{4R}$. The exterior cone gives a scale-independent lower bound for the relative measure outside $\Omega $, producing an oscillation recurrence with an additional boundary-oscillation term. Lemma 8.23 yields (8.72).

□
